units.title: Sharing a Chapati
units.description: Understanding that one whole can be broken into equal pieces.
steps: Fold it exactly in the middle to make two equal parts.

units.title: Equal vs Unequal Parts
units.description: Learning that fractions only work when parts are exactly the same size.
steps: Look at a square cut into two different sized pieces. Is this half? No.
Look at a square cut into two same sized pieces. Is this half? Yes.
